args.goal: In the open Invite Vendor drawer, verify that Choose vendor profile offers both Manufacture/Trader and Broker, select Broker, complete the remaining required fields, click Next, verify the summary shows Broker as the selected profile, click Invite, and stop when the invitation success is shown.

steps.note: Performs and observes the profile selection, summary, and invitation flow on the already-open drawer.
Asserts that the invitation completed with a success message.
